description: This script generates a mime types configuration file for a web server based on the system's /etc/mime.types and some predefined mappings, with customization options and conflict resolution. It reads existing mime types, applies conflict resolutions, and outputs a structured configuration as Perl code.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the MIME type for a given file extension in the global hash.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds or updates a MIME type for an extension, with conflict resolution rules.

methods.name: print_type
methods.description: Prints a MIME type and extension mapping, appending charset for text types.
